text:
```yaml
name: PR Closer

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'  # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  close-prs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Close stale PRs
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          days-before-pr-stale: 30
          days-before-pr-close: 0
          exempt-pr-author: jdx
          exempt-pr-labels: keep-open
          close-pr-message: |
            This PR has been automatically closed due to inactivity. If you wish to reopen, please comment or open a new PR.
```
